description: This file defines the 'virtual' CKEDITOR.dataProcessor class, serving as a base interface for data processor objects responsible for transforming editor data between different formats, primarily HTML. It includes documentation for methods toHtml and toDataFormat, which handle conversion from input data to HTML and vice versa.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dataProcessor
classes.description: A base class (interface) representing a data processor responsible for transforming editor data between formats.

methods.name: toHtml
methods.description: Transforms input data into HTML to be loaded in the editor. Converts data from a specific format (e.g., BBCode) into HTML.

methods.name: toDataFormat
methods.description: Transforms HTML data into a specific data format used by the editor (e.g., BBCode).
